Subject: Offer of employment as Associate Software Engineer

Congratulations. We are glad to offer you a 6 month internship followed by a full-time role as Associate Software Engineer.
During the internship you will receive a stipend of Rs. 25,000 per month.
On conversion to a full-time role your annual CTC will be Rs. 7,20,000, as given below.

Basic | 2,88,000
HRA | 1,44,000
Special Allowance | 2,52,547

Gratuity | 13,853
All amounts are per annum.

Conversion is subject to a satisfactory performance review at the end of the internship.
PF is calculated on the Rs. 15,000 monthly wage ceiling.
After conversion, you will be on probation for 3 months.
The notice period is 30 days.
